title: Higher-round AES versus naive-inversion MEDP ordering
summary: Decide whether AES has lower maximum expected differential probability than the corresponding naive-inversion construction at every round count above two.

formal_statement.body: For every integer $r>2$, is $\operatorname{MEDP}_r(\text{AES S-box})<\operatorname{MEDP}_r(\text{naive inversion})$ for the otherwise corresponding AES-like construction under the source-defined key-averaged MEDP model? Prove the inequality for all $r>2$ or refute it by one exact compatible comparison.

scope.domain: Multi-round maximum expected differential probability of AES and its naive-inversion S-box variant.
assumptions: The construction and key-averaged MEDP definition are those used by the inspected 2015 source.
The compared constructions differ only by the stated affine representative of inversion.
scope.unresolved_remainder: No proof of the strict comparison for every $r>2$ and no exact reversing comparison for any such round was found.

progress.summary: The source asks whether the two-round AES-versus-naive-inversion MEDP ordering persists for every higher round count.
